ops.sql: SELECT Name, Object_Type, Stereotype, Package_ID FROM t_object WHERE (Name LIKE 'UC-%' OR Name LIKE 'UCR-%' OR Name LIKE 'BRU%' OR Name LIKE 'LS%') AND Object_Type IN ('UseCase','Collaboration','Requirement','Class','Object') ORDER BY Name LIMIT 60
SELECT Package_ID, Name, Parent_ID FROM t_package WHERE Name IN ('ACTORS','RULES (REUSABLE)','GLOBAL VIEWS','OTHER ELEMENTS','Business Applications') OR Name LIKE 'UC-%' LIMIT 40
SELECT Object_ID, Name, Object_Type, Stereotype, Package_ID FROM t_object WHERE Stereotype IN ('Logical Screen','Logical Screen Part','Behavioral Rule','Use Case Realization') LIMIT 20
